decision.explanation: The provided documents contain contradictory assertions regarding the electoral district associated with Larré. Document 1 (D1S5, D1S6, D1S8) explicitly states Larré is associated with the 'canton of Écouves'. Document 2 (D2S4, D2S11) explicitly states Larré is associated with the 'Canton of La Région Limouxine'. Per the instruction to keep supported alternate referents rather than selecting one familiar winner and to treat all audits as fallible, both distinct claims found in the source text are preserved as valid answers.
